# MonShop: code map

<!-- generated by APP_MAKER/standard/app_map.py · 2026-11-06 · code 6012a9a888e8 · regenerate after every change -->

**Read this first, then open only the files it points to.** Line numbers are where definitions start; read
around them with an offset instead of whole files.

**What it is:** See what independent shops, cafés and restaurants near you have today, from real shelf photos and specials, and get 5% off where you are a regular.
**Live:** https://monshop.ca · **Repo:** github.com/arkulinskis/monshop · **Layout:** classic Anvil repo with a JavaScript front end (not native Forms yet) · **Deploy:** master
**Guide** (workflow, design rules, product knowledge): `.claude/skills/monshop/SKILL.md`

## How to change it

- This folder **is** the Anvil repo. The front end is JavaScript in `theme/assets/`, started by the client form(s) below;
  the server is `server_code/`.
- **New server function**: `@anvil.server.callable` in `server_code`; the JavaScript reaches it through the form's bridge (see *Client side*).
- **New table/column**: `anvil.yaml` → `db_schema` (the user accepts Anvil's Schema Mismatch alert).
- **Check**: `python -I APP_MAKER/tools/gitapp_check.py <key>`; server tests: `python -I APP_MAKER/tools/gitapp_test.py`.
- **Deploy**: commit as arkulinskis (+ Co-Authored-By) and `git push origin master` (pull first: Anvil commits too).
- **Footer** must keep: Submit feedback (Prepsto), Privacy & Terms, Contact developer (arkvital.com), Parent company (addanapp.com).
- **After any change**: `python -I C:/Users/arkvi/Documents/CLAUDE/APP_MAKER/standard/app_map.py monshop` refreshes this map.

## Data tables (`anvil.yaml` db_schema)

- **users**: email:str, enabled:bool, last_login:dt, password_hash:str, n_password_failures:num, confirmed_email:bool, signed_up:dt, remembered_logins:obj, email_confirmation_key:str, display_name:str, is_admin:bool, legal_version:str, legal_accepted_at:dt, legal_source:str · used in api_admin
- **places**: owner→users, name:str, kind:str, category:str, emoji:str, color:str, tagline:str, about:str, address:str, lat:num, lng:num, hours:str, phone:str, website:str, currency:str, cover:media, status:str, reject_reason:str, created:dt, updated:dt, reviewed_at:dt, reviewed_by→users, special:str, special_until:dt, views:num, bookmarks:num, passes_shown:num, last_post:dt, search_text:str, is_demo:bool · used in api_admin, api_council, api_public, api_seller, api_shopper, common, seed
- **items**: place→places, photo:media, thumb:media, title:str, price:num, unit:str, note:str, emoji:str, color:str, is_special:bool, pinned:bool, sold_out:bool, active:bool, created:dt, updated:dt, is_demo:bool · used in api_admin, api_public, api_seller, api_shopper, common, seed
- **bookmarks**: user→users, place→places, created:dt, pass_count:num, last_pass:dt · used in api_admin, api_public, api_seller, api_shopper, seed
- **visits**: user→users, place→places, day:str, created:dt · used in api_seller, api_shopper, seed
- **reports**: item→items, place→places, user→users, reason:str, created:dt, resolved:bool · used in api_admin, api_seller, api_shopper, seed
- **ideas**: author→users, place→places, title:str, body:str, votes:num, demo_votes:num, status:str, admin_note:str, created:dt, is_demo:bool · used in api_admin, api_council, api_seller, seed
- **idea_votes**: idea→ideas, user→users, created:dt · used in api_admin, api_council, seed
- **settings**: key:str, value:obj · used in common
